coverage_notes:
PRIMARY SOURCE: The school's own football staff directory, page-titled "2024-25 Football Staff", archived on the Wayback Machine at https://web.archive.org/web/20250124220147/https://ohiostatebuckeyes.com/sports/football/coaches/ — captured January 24, 2025, four days after the January 20, 2025 CFP National Championship win over Notre Dame. This snapshot is confirmed to reflect the 2024 season staff (not a 2025 rebuild) because it still lists Chip Kelly as OC and Jim Knowles as DC; both departed in February 2025 (Kelly to the Raiders, Knowles to Penn State). It contains two tables, "Coaching Staff" (27 rows) and "Support Staff" (35 rows, of which Parker Wereb is duplicated, giving 34 unique people). Only ONE Wayback snapshot of this page exists for the 2024-25 window, so no mid-season diffing was possible.

SECONDARY SOURCE: Official Ohio State game notes PDF for the January 10, 2025 CFP semifinal (Cotton Bowl) vs. Texas, https://ohiostatebuckeyes.com/documents/download/2025/1/6/15_TEX.pdf. It has an "ASSISTANT COACHES/SUPPORT STAFF" summary block and an "ANALYSTS / QUALITY CONTROL / GRADUATE STUDENT COACHES" page with "Name // Title" entries. It supplied eight people absent from the web directory: Billy Fessler, Carey Hoyt, four team physicians (Chris Kaeding, David Flanigan, Ryan Rauck, Bryant Walrod), and two athletics communications staffers (Jerry Emig, Mike Basford).

QUOTE-MATCHING CAVEATS — please read before mechanically matching:
1. The archived directory is an HTML TABLE. Each person's name and title live in SEPARATE <td> cells, so "Name Title" never appears as one contiguous string anywhere in the page, in raw HTML or in any text conversion. I therefore set quote to the person's NAME (the longest contiguous, faithfully-copyable string that identifies them) and put the exact adjacent Title-column text in the note for every row. The role field also carries the title verbatim.
2. The raw HTML of that page contains a DOUBLE SPACE between first and last name for roughly half the entries (e.g. "Jim  Knowles", "Larry  Johnson", "Quinn  Tempel", "Mark  Pantoni"). Browsers and most HTML-to-text converters collapse this to one space. My quotes use the SINGLE-SPACE rendered form. If a match fails, normalize runs of whitespace before comparing.
3. WebFetch in this environment is hard-blocked from web.archive.org; I retrieved the snapshot with curl, which works fine. A verifier using a blocked fetcher will fail on these URLs for transport reasons, not content reasons.
4. The live URL https://ohiostatebuckeyes.com/sports/football/coaches/2024-25 is client-side rendered and its HTML contains ZERO staff names, so it is unusable as a citation target. The Wayback snapshot is the only fetchable server-rendered copy.
5. For the game-notes PDF, quote is set to "" per instructions: the embedded text extracts with ligature corruption ("fi"/"ff" become control bytes), injected "en-US" language markers, and run-together words at text-run boundaries, so it cannot be copied faithfully. The note gives the reconstructed listing text.

WHAT I COULD NOT DOCUMENT:
- No mid-season arrivals or departures were found, so no midseason_note is set on anyone. I could not affirmatively rule them out, because only a single post-championship snapshot of the staff page exists. Everyone listed is documented as on staff either four days after the title game or ten days before it.
- Parker Fleming, special teams coordinator through 2023, is deliberately EXCLUDED. He was dismissed in January 2024, before the 2024 season. Ohio State did not replace him with an on-field ST coach; special teams were handled by Rob Keys (Quality Control - Kicking / Special Teams Analyst) and Gunner Daniel (Program Assistant - Special Teams). The 2024 on-field staff is exactly 10 assistants plus the head coach.
- I could not locate the CFP National Championship game notes PDF itself (vs. Notre Dame). I probed several plausible URL patterns under /documents/download/2025/1/*/16_ND.pdf and 16_NCG.pdf; all returned HTTP 500. The Texas semifinal notes are the latest official game-notes staff listing I could retrieve.
- I could not find a 2024 media guide with a fuller support-staff roster, so headcounts for large support units (athletic training, creative media, video, recruiting) are limited to those the school chose to list publicly. The real support organization is likely larger than 69.
- Wikipedia's 2024 team page has no full coaching-staff section, only an infobox (head coach and three coordinators) and a "Coaching staff changes" section. It is cited only as a corroborating second source for those four.
- Spelling variance: the web directory reads "Quinn  Tempel" while the game notes read "Quinn Temple". The directory spelling (with the osu.edu email tempel.2@osu.edu) is authoritative and is what I used.
- Kaila Olson's directory row includes post-nominals as part of the name cell: "Kaila  Olson MS, RD, LD". I quote the bare name.
- Nothing in this dataset is inferred or padded. Every one of the 69 rows traces to a fetched page or PDF I read directly.
